title: runtime-1.19: release notes + changelog updates for kernel selector v2 rollout
author: Connor O'Brien
description: Summary: Updates internal runtime-1.19 release notes and CHANGELOG entries to accurately reflect kernel auto-selection v2 landing in 1.19 (feature-flagged, default-off initially) and to document rollout/rollback knobs, telemetry, and known caveats discovered in canary. Context: This PR is intentionally documentation-only but is used as the source-of-truth for Release Eng + SRE when cutting 1.19 and staging selector v2 enablement. What’s included: (1) Release notes section “Kernel selector v2 (table-driven)” with expected performance impact framing (p95 stability across GPU SKUs; better mixed prefill/decode behavior), (2) Config/flags section describing selector version flag, kill switch, and per-model-family overrides (including precedence order), (3) Observability section listing required metrics/trace annotations (selector_version, kernel_id, model_family, seq_bucket, gpu_sku_normalized) with explicit cardinality guidance, (4) Rollout plan summary (internal canary -> 5% hosted -> 25% hosted -> dedicated opt-in -> default-on) and rollback criteria pointer to SRE guardrails, (5) Known issues note about unknown model family behavior (safe kernel set fallback) and seq-bucket boundary sensitivity (off-by-one fix is in-flight/landed separately). Non-goals: No code changes; no new runtime behavior; no customer-facing API changes. References: ENG-3934 (rollout execution), ENG-3931 (flag wiring), ENG-3927 (telemetry), INT-2331 (dashboards panel).
commits: docs(release): add runtime-1.19 entry for kernel selector v2 + rollout notes
docs(changelog): include selector v2 behind flag + debug/telemetry bullets
docs(runtime): add override/rollback snippet + link to runbook
review_conversation: Grace Kim: Please make it explicit that selector v2 is table-driven but still falls back to v1 heuristics when a table entry is missing; also call out deterministic tie-break behavior (we’ve had confusion in perf triage). Connor O'Brien (author): Added a sentence under “Selection behavior” describing: table lookup first; if no match -> safe kernel set -> v1 selector; and a note that ties are resolved by stable priority order (registry order + kernel_priority). Allison Grant: Telemetry section needs to be consistent with the cardinality standards: we should not encourage logging raw model_id or raw prompt length. Prefer model_family + seq_bucket and normalized gpu_sku only. Connor O'Brien (author): Updated telemetry bullets to only list allowed labels and added “DO NOT emit model_id/prompt_len as labels” callout; left a note that raw values are acceptable only in sampled debug logs. Aisha Bello: Rollback criteria should point to the exact SLO guardrails doc and include the two metrics we expect to watch during stage 0/1 (p95 latency and error rate). Connor O'Brien (author): Added links + included the minimal watchlist (p95 end-to-end latency by gpu_sku + 5xx/timeout rate) and a reminder that correctness signals (NaN guard) should be checked in traces. Benji Okafor: Please include the exact config keys (names + precedence) as they appear in runtime config, or at least link to the canonical config doc. Connor O'Brien (author): Added config key names and precedence order in the release notes and linked to docs/ops/runtime/config-flags.md. Mateo Alvarez: Looks good; make sure we don’t oversell perf gains. Phrase as “expected improvement / reduced variance” and call out that results depend on workload distribution. Connor O'Brien (author): Adjusted wording accordingly. Approvals: Grace Kim approved; Allison Grant approved; Aisha Bello approved; Benji Okafor approved; Mateo Alvarez approved.
release_notes:
- runtime-1.19 includes kernel auto-selection v2 (feature-flagged, default-off at initial cut)
- Adds documented rollout/rollback controls: selector version flag, kill switch, per-model-family overrides (precedence clarified)
- Adds required observability fields for selection decisions (selector_version, kernel_id, model_family, seq_bucket, normalized gpu SKU) with cardinality guidance
- Documents staged rollout plan and SRE rollback criteria pointers; notes known caveats around unknown model families and seq-bucket boundaries
merge_outcome: Merged into release/runtime-1.19 via squash; queued for inclusion in the runtime-1.19 cut notes used by Release Engineering and SRE during staged rollout.
